name: dvein-hrm
description: Dvein HRM — console, public registration form, and API

scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend/console build && pnpm --dir frontend/registration build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend/console lint && pnpm --dir frontend/registration lint
scripts.deploy:api: gcloud run deploy dvein-hrm-api --source ./backend --region asia-south1 --allow-unauthenticated --update-env-vars AUTOMATION_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=true
